name: stage_1_stand_symmetric
description: Stand to a symmetric base first (E1b fr_blend on, homeo OFF), advance at ~80s.  The per-tick brain forms the dynamically-stable stance before the per-step walking signal turns on.

name: stage_2_homeokinetic_walk
description: (a) — per-STEP homeokinetic reward turns on: events.hit fires on each touchdown with magnitude = homeo_step_gain x foot_excursion x step_regularity x upright.  Rewards SUSTAINED RHYTHMIC stepping (a lurch is irregular -> ~0 reward, so no Goodhart like the 3n gait-cycle pulse).  standing_baseline_factor reduced to 0.3 so the per-tick standing reward keeps balance but no longer dominates -> the per-step homeo signal has room to drive walking.  fr_blend stays on (symmetric base).  Test: does the brain learn to step rhythmically to earn the homeo reward (foot_autocorr climbs over the run)?
